prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 行高瓶颈转移 · 故障复盘 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "模块" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 2: header "问题描述" · longest unbreakable word 49px · one-line width 578px
  col 3: header "影响范围" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 530px
  col 4: header "修复方案" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 659px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"通过故障复盘对照各模块的问题、影响和修复方案，验证行高瓶颈如何转移。","reading":"读者先按模块定位，再横向阅读同一行的描述、影响和方案；也可纵向比较各模块的影响或修复方式。截图中后两列的具体内容未完整显示，因此判断主要依据列标题和给定的内容宽度。","groups":["问题描述、影响范围和修复方案共同构成每个故障的复盘链条，需要在同一行内保持清晰关联。","影响范围和修复方案都是对问题的后续说明，适合保留足够的阅读宽度。"],"keep_intact":["模块名称和列标题尽量完整显示。","数字、时间、单位及可能出现的标识符应尽量保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["问题描述、影响范围和修复方案中的中文叙述可自然换行。","较短单元格可以利用同一行中较长叙述产生的行高；具体换行效果取决于截图未完整显示的内容。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [52, 100, 98, 109] · table 360×671px · row heights [36, 199, 176, 222, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 9 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [52, 98, 105, 104] · table 360×671px · row heights [36, 199, 176, 222, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 9 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [52, 112, 96, 99] · table 360×717px · row heights [36, 199, 222, 222, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 9 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"四个表头和模块名称均完整，三列复盘内容紧邻排列；HTTPS 等标识符没有被拆开。影响范围和修复方案各自的长内容分布在不同行，横向对应关系清楚。","problems":"网关问题描述、订单影响范围和搜索修复方案都被挤成较窄的文字带，行高分别由这三个单元格主导，其他单元格因此留下较大空白。","cause":"模块列为52px，后三列分别为100、98、109px；扣除内边距和边框后，长叙述的有效宽度只有79、77、88px。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"表头、模块名称和标识符完整，影响范围增加到105px后，订单行的叙述较r1C更舒展；总高度与r1A相同，三列宽度也较均衡。","problems":"网关问题描述仍然很窄，搜索修复方案形成长而密的文字带；较短单元格旁有明显空白，阅读一行时需要跨越较大的垂直距离。","cause":"问题描述和修复方案仅分别为98px和104px，扣除21px后有效宽度为77px和83px，长内容仍需多次换行。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"问题描述列加宽后，网关行的文字略舒展，表头和模块名称仍完整，标识符也保持完整。","problems":"订单影响范围收窄后多出换行，订单行明显增高；搜索修复方案仍然拥挤。问题描述加宽没有降低网关行高度，却让整表比另外两版更长。","cause":"问题描述增至112px，而影响范围和修复方案降至96px、99px；影响范围只有75px有效宽度，成为订单行的高度瓶颈。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r2A","widths":[52,100,105,102],"change":"以r1B为基础，小幅增加问题描述宽度并保留105px的影响范围，检验能否改善网关行，同时控制订单行高度。"},{"name":"r2B","widths":[52,98,101,108],"change":"将部分宽度从影响范围转给修复方案，检验搜索行能否减少换行，以及订单行是否仍保持可接受的高度。"},{"name":"r2C","widths":[48,100,105,106],"change":"将模块列收至48px，仍为两个汉字保留27px有效宽度；把节省的空间分给三列叙述，探索更宽的内容列能否改善整体节奏。"}]}
